brief:
Israeli settlers are intensifying operations against Palestinian communities near Ramallah through arson and land seizures, Middle East Eye reported. The campaign targets villages in the region as settlers expand their control over Palestinian territory.

The attacks coincide with a sharp increase in settler violence during the olive harvest season, according to UN documentation that has recorded unprecedented levels of such incidents. The escalation reflects a broader pattern of settlement expansion in the occupied West Bank.

title: Settlers escalate attacks on Palestinian villages near Ramallah
